entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the network wishes to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE. It requires that both the UE and network support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options supported end-to-end
entities.description: Condition that both UE and network support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Network transmits protocol data to UE
entities.description: Network behavior of transmitting protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

relations.description: Inclusion of the extended protocol configuration options IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support it end-to-end for the PDN connection.
When the extended protocol configuration options are supported end-to-end, the network can transmit protocol data to the UE.
